correctness.rationale: Characteristic-two group algebra of a finite 2-group is local with cotangent space dim 2. Explicit group-basis multiplication gives the square-zero radical cone: Q8 exactly the four-dimensional central cA ideal, D8 union of two five-dimensional spaces meeting in cA. A nontrivial proper algebra retract has cotangent dimension one; the group relations force its generators to be square-zero, excluding Q8 because cA lies in J^2. For D8 each normalized nonzero tangent direction has q^4 square-zero representatives and q choices of splitting, giving 2q^5 maps of vector rank two; rank one augmentation and rank eight identity. Independently implemented GF2 exhaustive generator-image/evaluation test confirms D8 (1,64,1) and Q8 (1,1), and GF4 exhaustive augmentation-ideal square-zero census confirms D8 central/noncentral (256,1536), Q8 (256,0). Characteristic-two arbitrary-field proof is algebraic, not inferred from the finite tests.
residual_risks: The GF4 experiment tests the key cone but not all q; the symbolic cone proof supplies the universal field statement.
Idempotent algebra endomorphisms must not be confused with idempotent elements.

value.rationale: An explicit complete rank spectrum and embedding/splitting census for algebra retracts is a natural structural invariant distinguishing notoriously similar modular group algebras. The q-dependence and strict Q8 rigidity go beyond a relabeling or a few experimental values.
residual_risks: Small group order is specialized but provides a genuine first structural contrast, not an arbitrary computational slice.

limitations: Counts unital coefficient-field algebra endomorphism retractions, not arbitrary group endomorphisms or ring idempotent elements.
Exact polynomial only for order eight, q a power of 2.
